Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Reorder pipeline: concepts before images, per-concept image hunt on Generate Poster

- Pipeline now generates ad concepts immediately after homepage summarise,
  without waiting for image hunt \(faster UX\)
- Image hunt moved to on-demand: clicking Generate Poster on a concept runs
  the image hunt against ALL asset_candidates with that concept as context,
  then chains straight into poster generation
- Carousel stays above concepts \(as before\) but now explains its role as the
  pool the AI will search per-concept
- smb_image_hunt_system.txt: major rewrite using OOH Image Hunt Reference Guide —
  adds 7-factor scoring rubric, +15pt concept-specific bonus, OOH distance tests,
  8-type taxonomy, 10 industry playbooks, logo detection priority, failure mode table
- smb_image_hunt_user.txt: adds {concept_context} and {concept_task_line}
  placeholders for targeted vs global hunts
- call_n8n_image_hunt: adds optional concept param that injects concept brief
  into the prompt and payload
- state.py: adds concept_visual_packs session state \(per-concept visual packs\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
